Guideline: Define collections with a loader in src/content.config.ts
Description: Since Astro 6 all collections use the Content Layer API: define them in src/content.config.ts with a loader such as glob() or file() from astro/loaders and a schema built with z from astro/zod. Legacy collections (src/content/config.ts, type: 'content' or 'data', no loader) were removed; entries are identified by id, not slug, and rendered with render(entry) from astro:content.
Do: defineCollection({ loader: glob({ pattern, base }), schema }) in src/content.config.ts
Don't: Legacy src/content/config.ts collections without a loader, entry.slug or entry.render()
Code Good: import { defineCollection } from 'astro:content'; import { glob } from 'astro/loaders'; import { z } from 'astro/zod'; const blog = defineCollection({ loader: glob({ base: './src/content/blog', pattern: '**/*.{md,mdx}' }), schema: z.object({ title: z.string(), pubDate: z.coerce.date() }) }); export const collections = { blog };
Code Bad: // src/content/config.ts: defineCollection({ type: 'content', schema }) // legacy collection, removed in Astro 6

Guideline: Opt individual routes into on-demand rendering
Description: Since Astro 5 the static output prerenders every route unless a page or endpoint exports prerender = false; output: 'hybrid' was removed because static now behaves that way. On-demand routes still need an adapter.
Do: export const prerender = false on routes that must render per request, with an adapter installed
Don't: output: 'hybrid' (removed in Astro 5), or server rendering for a fully static site
Code Bad: export default defineConfig({ output: 'hybrid' }) // removed in Astro 5

Guideline: Add Tailwind 4 through the Vite plugin

Description: Data fetching in component frontmatter

Guideline: Astro.glob() is removed; use import.meta.glob() or collections
Description: Astro.glob() was deprecated in Astro 5 and removed in Astro 6. Query structured content with getCollection(); for other files use Vite's import.meta.glob(), which returns synchronously.
Do: getCollection('blog') for content; import.meta.glob() for other files
Code Good: const posts = await getCollection('blog'); const icons = import.meta.glob('./icons/*.svg', { eager: true });
Code Bad: const posts = await Astro.glob('./posts/*.md') // removed in Astro 6

Description: Declare variables in an astro:env schema with envField to get type checking and to separate client from server values; import them from astro:env/client or astro:env/server. With import.meta.env, only variables prefixed PUBLIC_ reach client code.
Do: env.schema with envField(...context, access) and imports from astro:env/*
Don't: Expose secrets to client code or read untyped variables everywhere
Code Good: // astro.config: env: { schema: { API_URL: envField.string({ context: 'client', access: 'public' }), API_SECRET: envField.string({ context: 'server', access: 'secret' }) } } // import { API_SECRET } from 'astro:env/server';

Description: <ViewTransitions /> was renamed to <ClientRouter /> in Astro 5 and removed in Astro 6. Import it from astro:transitions and add it to the shared <head>. It disables all transition animations when prefers-reduced-motion is set, and its fallback prop controls browsers without the View Transition API.
Do: <ClientRouter /> from astro:transitions in the shared head
Code Bad: import { ViewTransitions } from 'astro:transitions'; // removed in Astro 6

Description: transition:name pairs an element on the old and new page so it animates between them; each name can be used only once per page.
transition:persist keeps an element and its state, such as a playing video, across navigations to a page that contains the same element.
With <ClientRouter />, navigation swaps the page without a full reload, so some scripts no longer re-run. Listen for the astro:page-load event to set up listeners on every navigation.
Don't: Assume module scripts run again after a client-side navigation
Code Bad: setupMenu(); // runs once; listeners are lost after navigating

Guideline: Write head metadata in a shared layout
Description: Astro does not ship an SEO component: put <title>, meta description and canonical tags in a shared layout or head component and pass page values as props. Build canonical URLs from Astro.url and the configured site.
Do: Layout head with title, description and canonical built from Astro.url
Code Good: <title>{title}</title><meta name="description" content={description} /><link rel="canonical" href={new URL(Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site)} />

Guideline: Remark and rehype plugins need the unified processor in Astro 7
Description: Astro 7 renders Markdown and MDX with Sätteri and no longer installs @astrojs/markdown-remark. To keep remark or rehype plugins, install @astrojs/markdown-remark and set markdown.processor to unified(); the markdown.remarkPlugins and rehypePlugins options are deprecated and also require that package.
Do: markdown: { processor: unified() } when the project depends on remark/rehype plugins
Don't: Expect remarkPlugins/rehypePlugins to work in Astro 7 without @astrojs/markdown-remark
Code Good: import { unified } from '@astrojs/markdown-remark'; export default defineConfig({ markdown: { processor: unified() } });
Code Bad: markdown: { remarkPlugins: [remarkToc] } // deprecated; requires @astrojs/markdown-remark in Astro 7

Prefetching is built in: set prefetch: true in astro.config and opt links in with data-astro-prefetch (hover by default; tap, viewport and load are other strategies). <ClientRouter /> sets prefetchAll: true by default. The @astrojs/prefetch integration was deprecated in v3.5.0.
Do: prefetch: true plus data-astro-prefetch on links

Guideline: Check inline whitespace and markup after upgrading to Astro 7
Description: Astro 7 changed compressHTML's default from true to 'jsx', so whitespace between inline elements follows JSX rules: helloworld renders without a space. Its Rust compiler is stricter: unclosed tags are errors and invalid HTML nesting is no longer auto-corrected.
Do: Add explicit {" "} where inline elements need a space, or set compressHTML: true
Don't: Assume v6 whitespace and lenient HTML parsing after upgrading
